about_the_game:
Hop into the world of FrogSpin, where a wind-up frog with big dreams takes center stage! Leap across dazzling fruit tiles, spin slot machines, and navigate unpredictable weather conditions and other chaotic modifiers. Every move is crucial! Utilizing simple two-button controls—tapping for quick hops and holding for dramatic leaps—you will guide the frog to glory. 🐸✨

🎯 Skill Meets Strategy: Master precision jumps or revel in hilarious missteps—it’s all part of the charm.

🚗 Transformations: Dash as a toy car, float like a bubble, or smash through tiles with the power of a drill.

🌈 Adorable Visuals: Bright, cheerful, and irresistibly croak-worthy.

🎰 Slot Machine Madness: Face randomly selected modifiers like slippery rain, gusty winds, balloon gravity, and more, making every level a unique challenge.

💰 Point Collecting Fun: Rack up points and reap big rewards—collecting shiny points has never been so satisfying!

🎩 Accessorize: Unlock quirky hats and accessories, some with unique powers. Use them across modes and showcase your froggy flair!

🛠️ Training Mode: Play at your own pace with unlimited lives, unlocking and clearing levels as you go. For an extra challenge, aim to collect all the fruits in each level or beat your personal best times.

🎲 Roulette Mode: Take on the ultimate roguelike challenge with limited lives and ever-changing levels. Each roll brings a new random level and a set of unpredictable modifiers, like wacky weather or unique effects that can ease or intensify the chaos.
detailed_description:
Demo Notes

Hello and thanks for trying our demo! This version of FrogSpin features a 20-level introduction in Training Mode as well as over 35 levels in Roulette Mode.

We’re hard at work expanding the full game with even more content, and we’d love to hear your feedback, ideas, or wild suggestions as we shape FrogSpin’s future. If you like what you see, please add FrogSpin to your wishlist and spread the word. Your support means a lot! 🙏 Stay tuned for more surprises 🕵️
